name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard terms for a mutual NDA allowing both parties to share confidential information for a defined purpose.

name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
description: Fill-in cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, including fields for purpose, effective date, term, and governing law.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for a cloud SaaS subscription, covering access and use, restrictions, privacy, payment, term, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement for early-access design partner programs, covering product access, feedback obligations, IP ownership, and confidentiality.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: SLA terms defining uptime and response-time targets, service credits, and remedies for cloud services.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard terms for professional services engagements, covering SOW-based delivery, IP assignment, payment, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: GDPR-compliant DPA governing how a provider processes personal data on behalf of a customer, including SCCs and UK Addendum.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms for an on-premise software license, covering license grant, restrictions, payment, warranties, liability, and confidentiality.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Standard terms for business partnerships, covering obligations, trademark licensing, payment, confidentiality, indemnification, and liability.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Short-term product evaluation agreement allowing a customer to test a product for a defined pilot period before committing to a full agreement.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA-compliant BAA governing a provider's handling of Protected Health Information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to a base agreement governing AI/ML service usage, covering model training restrictions, IP ownership of inputs and outputs, and AI-specific disclaimers.
